features.feature: Live IRSA search (SPHEREx DR1 + QR3) with checksums
features.limitations: Needs IRSA online; a release that does not answer is labelled PARTIAL, a cached listing is labelled CACHED.

features.feature: Cutouts and per-epoch quality checks (18 flag planes, variance, wavelength at the star)
features.limitations: Published numbers read the wavelength with astropy's WCS (SIP shift up to 18 nm); a corrected mode exists.

features.feature: Wavelength audit against official CWAVE/CBAND, selectable wavelength source
features.limitations: Published numbers stay on the legacy source for reproducibility; cwave changes no conclusion.

features.feature: Comparability rules, refusals and compatibility graph
features.limitations: Pair rule (same detector, |Δλ| ≤ half a channel) equals a top-hat overlap ≥ 0.5, not the full response curve.

features.feature: Aperture photometry, difference and significance maps
features.limitations: 6.15″ pixels: RW Aur A+B unresolved; fluxes are relative, not absolutely calibrated.

features.feature: Null test and SIMULATED injection-recovery
features.limitations: Injections are added after reprojection, so they test detection, not the full pipeline.

features.feature: Stability fingerprint (robustness across analysis settings)
features.limitations: Labels follow fixed rules; they are not probabilities.

features.feature: Evidence graph to dataset DOIs and claims registry
Catalogue match (SIMBAD, Gaia DR3)
features.limitations: Needs network; CDS mirrors were used during an outage.

features.feature: Comparison with IRSA's own tools (Source Discovery Tool, MOST)
features.limitations: The Spectrophotometry Tool is web-only and was not run.

features.feature: ePSF photometry (second, independent measurement)
features.limitations: χ²_ν 4–18 on bright cores; not used by any published number.
features.next_step: Model field stars and sky structure in the fit.

features.feature: PSF-matched / ZOGY image subtraction benchmark
features.limitations: No method passed the rule fixed before running; not adopted.

features.feature: Joint PSF fit of RW Aur A and B
features.limitations: Result is negative: SPHEREx does not separate A and B (fluxes anti-correlated, −0.92 to −0.997).

features.feature: Moving objects: blind linking validated on (216) Kleopatra vs JPL Horizons (observer SPHEREx)
features.limitations: Known asteroid; validation, not a discovery. 3-visit tracks can be chance alignments.

features.feature: Moving objects: (2052) Tamriko (faint) and (433) Eros (fast) vs JPL Horizons
features.limitations: Three known asteroids over a few days each; an order-2 path model is too simple for Eros (χ²_ν 63).

features.feature: Track vetting (static stars, detector hits)
features.limitations: Removes the static-star/detector-hit track in the Kleopatra field; does not remove chance alignments of 3–4 single detections.
features.next_step: Add a false-alarm estimate per track.

features.feature: Wide search for unknown movers / Planet X
features.limitations: HIPPARCHUS has not found Planet X and does not claim it.
features.next_step: Run linking over many fields with a measured false-alarm rate.

features.feature: All-Sky Explorer (Aladin Lite on the SPHEREx DR1 HiPS)
features.limitations: The HiPS is a coadd, not a time series; Aladin Lite (GPL-3.0) is loaded from jsDelivr at runtime.

features.feature: Spectral Explorer (wavelength and flux per exposure)
features.limitations: Never coadds; three targets precomputed.

features.feature: Native-pixel and difference viewer
Reproduction bundles with a stand-alone checker
features.limitations: FITS are not inside; the checker downloads them again to detect archive drift.

features.feature: Mini reports (HTML/PDF) and reproduction notebooks
features.limitations: Built from the published evidence, not recomputed.

features.feature: Benchmark on 32 objects with a fixed held-out split
features.limitations: IRSA SIA answered HTTP 502 for the whole run; no held-out star metrics yet. 3 Y dwarfs did not resolve in Sesame.
features.next_step: python scripts/run_benchmark.py --online when IRSA is back (resumes from cache).

features.feature: Manim scene library (M01–M10)
features.limitations: Full render takes about 30 min.

features.feature: 29 s film (Remotion, with two Manim scenes)
features.limitations: Captions only, no voice; IRSA returned 502 during the screen recording, the cached listing is shown and labelled.

features.feature: Judge Mode page
features.limitations: Static and precomputed; the page generator asserts every card against the evidence.

features.feature: Research report
Six-slide deck
Public interactive app (free Hugging Face Space)
features.limitations: Image built and verified locally; not deployed (needs the team's own Hugging Face login).

features.feature: Machine-learning ranking of candidates
features.limitations: No labelled data to train or test it fairly; we use fixed rules instead.
